uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Driver of the Dead

624-728-2777.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3499-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3179-4399-4770-5468.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Kambal trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kambal trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4770-5468.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3457-4360-7791.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Greenweaver Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Greenweaver Druid.
Repeat.

539-2244-4803-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4803-7730.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7726.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Virtuous Variant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

573-1558-2638-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1558-2638-4231-6753.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

339-677-2438-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5921-5970-7014-7175.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

141-1532-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-3967.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

856-1379-2921-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-1863-2167.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-1863-2167.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2558-2829-3490-4050.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1987-4002-4316-4423.easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4002-4316-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {3}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1329-1482-3152.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more ingredient counters on it

5224-5296-6675.description:
Cast Workhorse by paying {6}, causing it to enter the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter of each ingredient counter on Communal Brewing.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Workhorse.
Repeat step 2 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When Workhorse dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Workhorse from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

394-1445-2034-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-2034-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2719-4779-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-4779-5365.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
2719-4779-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

372-961-5913.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-5913.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1809-2080-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
1809-2080-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Returned Pastcaller, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

856-1201-1651-3169.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and another artifact you control, untapping Witch's Oven.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Caludron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.

220-4831-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Cacophodon indestructible.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
220-4831-5358.description:
Give Cacophodon indestructible, if needed.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G}, causing Brash Taunter and Cacophodon to fight each other.
Brash Taunter and Cacophodon trigger twice.
Resolve both Brash Taunter triggers, dealing damage equal to twice the damage dealt to Brash Taunter to an opponent.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping Wayta and the mana-producing permanent.
Repeat from step 2.

1379-1558-4338-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
1379-1558-4338-4875.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Clerics due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

692-4613-4659-5086.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-4613-4659-5086.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Triskelavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
When the Triskelavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Triskelavites, or activate their own abilities.

619-2092-4954.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 7 or greater.
619-2092-4954.description:
Activate Dormant Volcano by tapping it, adding {C}{R}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Dormant Volcano and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1512-2713-2816-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Stonybrook Schoolmaster does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle and Paradise Mantle attached to Stonybrook Schoolmaster.
1512-2713-2816-4474.description:
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by tapping it, adding {1}.
Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature token.
Activate Stonybrook Schoolmaster by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

654-4257-4499-4893.description:
Activate Emiel, exiling Golos and returning Golos to the battlefield.
Golos triggers, searching your library for a land and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Repeat.
